name: Thang Long
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Thang Long in Garmisch-Partenkirchen!**

Discover the vibrant atmosphere of **Thang Long**, the largest Vietnamese restaurant in **Tirol**, right in the heart of **Garmisch-Partenkirchen**. Indulge in authentic flavors from Vietnam, from fragrant **Phở** to crispy **Bánh Xèo**, all prepared with fresh local ingredients.

After your meal, take a stroll through the charming streets of **Garmisch-Partenkirchen** or enjoy the breathtaking views of the **Zugspitze**, Germany’s highest mountain. Whether you’re craving a taste of Asia or simply looking for a cozy dining experience, **Thang Long** offers a unique culinary adventure in the Alps.

**Come and experience the fusion of Vietnamese hospitality and Alpine charm!**
